title: Toner stock exists but cannot be found

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: The spreadsheet says five cartridges, but some are in vans, reserved or already delivered. Customers identify a printer by its location and sometimes photograph the wrong one. Leaving spare toner helped some sites but caused others to stockpile it.
retrieve_on.workflow_context: Printer rental and consumables provider; approximately 650 managed devices.

discriminating_questions.question: Is the warning an empty cartridge?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Some callers report the first low-toner warning while a spare is already on-site.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: If physical counts are accurate but consumption exceeds replenishment lead time, reorder policy rather than data capture is the main issue.

positive_mechanism: Missing location and reservation accounting combines with unreliable device and customer-stock identification.
counterexample: If physical counts are accurate but consumption exceeds replenishment lead time, reorder policy rather than data capture is the main issue.
minimum_evidence: A simulated stock audit separates warehouse, reserved and van quantities.
A simulated delivery receipt is absent from the stock sheet.
A simulated customer check finds two unopened spares.
process_intervention: Count high-use stock; assign device IDs; log transfers at handover; ask about usable on-site spare stock before urgent delivery.
automation_candidate: Maintain a location ledger and compatibility table; reserve stock atomically; suggest replenishment for human approval until counts are reliable.
unknowns: OEM compatibility, supplier lead times and actual usage distributions are not supplied.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Inventory ledger, asset compatibility and replenishment logic are proposed extensions.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
